div.div:
P2.1 Total = ∑ (Top-level P2.1 Score × Weight) / ∑ Weight
If the total top-level P2.1 weight is 0, the system falls back to the average of top-level P2.1 scores.
Line Scoring Guide
- Manual KPI
Binary: Pass = 100 points, Fail = 0 points.
Rating: 0 to 5 stars, each star = 20 points.
Score: enter the score directly into the score field.
- Auto KPI
Score is calculated from Target and Actual based on the selected Scoring Formula. If a data source is linked, the system can auto-fill Actual before applying the formula.
